bias_status: Zero bias retained as supported engineering assumption, not exact-AQ-model confirmation

comparison_sources.scope: SGX-7H2S and EC4-20-SO2 are listed at zero bias; exact AQ models absent. Power-off WE/RE shorting supports Skylark clamp topology.

Actual SENSOR_SO2 and SENSOR_H2S configuration sets LMP91000 BIAS_0_PERCENT; cpp configureLMP writes it to REFCN. Applies to SGX-4SO2 and SGX-4H2S-100, three-electrode cells, not the chosen four-electrode AQ models. Their 10-ohm loads/gains are not copied.

Alphasense B4 four-electrode hardware; native PCB inspection finds common +1V5 noninverting reference for potentiostat and measurement amplifiers. Separate WE/AE acquisition supports architecture, not SGX-specific bias or pressure qualification.

required_confirmation: WE-RE and AE-RE bias, polarity and tolerances for both exact AQ MPNs
Recommended four-electrode potentiostat, load, power-off shorting and stabilization requirements
Allowed absolute pressure and characterization/compensation below 800 mbar
Factory calibration, auxiliary-electrode correction and cross-sensitivity coefficients
search_result: No inspectable open-source implementation of either exact AQ MPN found in the public searches on 2026-09-27. Related designs corroborate zero bias but do not close the exact-model specification gap.
